items.title: Solana Will Now Print Less SOL as Disinflation Vote Passes in Dramatic Fashion
items.summary: The "Double Disinflation" proposal squeaked through by a razor-thin margin after Kraken nearly sank it, while a separate fee-burning measure failed.

items.title: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Trading Beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum
items.summary: The brokerage will expand Schwab Crypto trading to Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink, but has not given a launch date for the three tokens.

items.title: Bitwise fund is first Solana ETF to hit $1 billion AUM
items.summary: The Bitwise Solana Staking ETF (ticker BSOL) crossed $1 billion AUM on Friday, less than a year after its launch.

items.title: Morning Minute: Solana Jumps with Network Inflation Set to Drop
items.summary: Two majors proposals are set to pass, its leading DATs are back, and Schwab is offering SOL to its clients—quite the setup for Solana.

items.title: Agave 4.2: The Migration Checklist
items.summary: Learn about Agave 4.2 breaking changes and how to verify your integrations before mainnet feature gates activate.

items.title: DeFi Development Corp resumes Solana purchases, acquiring nearly 20,000 SOL
items.summary: DFDV's return has been more than twice that of SOL in the month of August, while quarter-to-date, shares have outperformed SOL by 1.8x.

items.title: Solana Is Having Its Best Month Since 2024—With a Historic Governance Vote on Deck
items.summary: Solana is up more than 8% in 24 hours and 44% on the month. Coming changes to the network could add a supply squeeze to the mix.

items.title: Charles Schwab to add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to crypto trading platform
items.summary: Schwab Crypto began rolling out to clients in May with direct access to BTC and ETH trading and charges 75 basis points per transaction.

items.title: The Token Supercycle Is Here: Solana Brings Breakpoint 2026 to London
items.summary: Breakpoint comes to London November 15–17, bringing 8,000+ attendees and leaders from capital markets, payments, technology and policy.

items.title: Galaxy Opens Retail Crypto-Backed Credit Lines on Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana
items.summary: GalaxyOne clients can borrow cash against Bitcoin, Ethereum, and staked Solana at 8.99% APR without selling a coin.

items.title: What is an LSM Tree? The Log-Structured Merge Tree Explained

items.title: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026
items.summary: Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Agave, Firedancer, and Solana Kit shipped updates.

items.title: Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic
items.summary: Solana will reduce its slot times from 400ms to 200ms. This change will make the protocol more competitive in terms of latency. Here we explore some possible implication on validators economic.
